name: Files, custom pages, localization, and system logs

requirements.text: Media files retain workspace/uploader ownership, opaque storage names, MIME/size/hash metadata, visibility, scan state, and soft deletion.
Safe custom pages use reserved-aware slugs, sanitized rich text, draft/published state, navigation placement, and SEO metadata.
Database locales and JSON translations support fallback English, direction, publication, and import/export without executable language files.
System logs contain application-owned queue, scheduler, and mail lifecycle records with filters, retention, and CSV export.

externalPrerequisites: ClamAV for production non-image upload scanning

acceptanceCriteria.text: Uploads reject executable, HTML, SVG, archive, and macro-capable types; accepted images are re-encoded to remove metadata.
Custom-page rich text is sanitized and cannot collide with reserved application routes.
Locale changes alter actual translated user/admin/public strings and fall back to English.
Admin logs never expose raw Laravel logs, request bodies, environment values, or secrets.

observedBehaviors: Uploaded files appear in a metadata table with owner, size, and time columns.
Custom pages are managed from a table with publication metadata and actions.
Locales are listed with language, direction, publication, and action columns.
Operational log records are presented in a filterable table with level and timestamp metadata.
